activationEpoch.purpose: Authorize Lane 01 to implement the shared Exchange Room lens controller and canonical 16-action registry while keeping every permanent lens visible/selectable and disabling only individual unavailable action controls.

workPacket.owner: Exchange Room Phase 2 — Lens Controller + 16-Action Registry
workPacket.basePolicy: Exact current-main activation after Phase 1 merge. Current explicit product-owner direction authorizes the permanent lens containers as selectable Room contexts while capability truthfulness is enforced at the individual action level.
workPacket.expectedOutput: One shared current-main Phase 2 candidate implementing a persistent lens controller and canonical sixteen-action registry. All four lenses remain visible/selectable Room contexts. Only individual inactive action controls are gray/disabled and non-actionable; no visible unavailable-status copy is added merely to explain the disabled state.
workPacket.stopBoundary: Do not implement missing domain features, Teaming, Intelligence datasets, Resource Provider workflows, referral lifecycle expansion, messaging, notifications, billing/payments, commercial policy, tracker completion, or Independent Verification.

productOwnerDirection.marketReadyBaseline: register → organization → Exchange Room/real market → four permanent lenses/value architecture → Founding Membership → live payment → recognized paid member
productOwnerDirection.lensRule: Every permanent lens remains visible and selectable as a real context of the shared Exchange Room regardless of unfinished functions.
productOwnerDirection.actionRule: Only the individual function button that is not usable for the current participant/selection is gray/disabled. Preserve its normal label and do not add visible unavailable/coming-soon style status copy merely to explain the disabled state.
productOwnerDirection.reasonSemantics: The projection must still distinguish not-operational, not-applicable and not-authorized reasons internally and in non-color-only accessibility/state semantics without adding visible status prose to the action grid.
